A. My name is Lily. I have a blue pencil case. There are two pencils, a ruler and three cards inside. I use the cards to practise English words.

B. I am Ben. My favourite subject is maths. My textbook is on the desk, and a timetable is beside it. I finish my homework before I play.

C. I am Sam. I like reading comics in the classroom library. The chair is comfortable, and I sit down there after class.
